crossRefs.note: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs.…
Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.
It will happen in that day that the nations will seek the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner of the peoples; and his…
But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me that is to be…
He shall stand, and shall shepherd in the strength of Yahweh, in the majesty of the name of Yahweh his God: and they…
Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.
For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.
which he worked in Christ, when he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly…
that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,
and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
But of the Son he says, “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your…
who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.
He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.”
For the king trusts in Yahweh. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”
He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.
But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’ ”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”
translations.bsb: A ruler will come from Jacob and destroy the survivors of the city.”
translations.kjv: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.
translations.asv: And out of Jacob shall one have dominion, And shall destroy the remnant from the city.
